Shabnam Sinha Appointed Chairperson of Airtel Payments Bank

Airtel Payments Bank has appointed Shabnam Sinha as its new chairperson, succeeding Sunil Mittal. Sinha's appointment is effective October 1, 2026, and she will serve a three-year term. The appointment is pending board approval and clearance from the Reserve Bank of India (RBI).
